_note: SINGLE SOURCE ของ Unity MCP commands — bridge (index.js) และ Unity C# (MCPHandlers.cs) อ่านไฟล์นี้ร่วมกัน. เพิ่ม/แก้ tool ที่นี่ที่เดียว. instance-management tools (unity_list_instances/select/start) เป็น local logic ไม่อยู่ในนี้ — hardcode ใน index.js.

commands.description: Check Unity Editor connection (active/selected instance)
Trigger Unity AssetDatabase.Refresh + RequestScriptCompilation — use after writing new scripts so Unity detects and compiles them without manual interaction
Check if Unity is still compiling scripts. Returns {isCompiling, status}. Poll this after unity_compile until isCompiling=false before calling unity_add_component or any type-dependent command.

Stop the Unity MCP server (TcpListener) from the AI side — used by /unity-mcp-close to fully close MCP. The server stops after this response flushes, so a subsequent unity_ping failing means stop succeeded.
Optimize UI in the active scene: disable raycastTarget on non-interactive Image/Text, disable pixelPerfect on Canvas, warn about heavy LayoutGroups. Requires Write ON.
List all scenes in the project
Get current scene hierarchy
Create a GameObject in the active scene
Delete a GameObject by name from the active scene
Create and save a Prefab asset to disk
Create a UI element in the active scene (auto-creates Canvas if needed)
Create a new Terrain in the scene, optionally generating hills with Perlin noise. For a flat floor use unity_create_gameobject with primitive 'plane'.
Apply heightmap to Terrain in the active scene (use scale for Perlin noise, or provide raw heights array)

scale.desc: Perlin noise scale (used when heights not provided)

heights.desc: Flat float array (sqrt(len) x sqrt(len)) of 0..1 height values

commands.description: Search for assets in the project by name and/or type

type.desc: Asset type e.g. Prefab, Texture2D, Material, Scene

commands.description: Instantiate an existing prefab asset into the active scene by name

name.desc: Prefab name to search for (e.g. P_HumanTrooperSword)

commands.description: Create a Material asset (URP Lit by default) with optional hex color
Pack all sprites in a folder into a Sprite Atlas to reduce draw calls
Report textures that should be optimized (oversized, uncompressed, read/write enabled)
Report assets that may be unused (REPORT ONLY — does not delete; Addressables/Resources not detected)
Report empty folders under Assets/
Count objects with a component type, split into active vs inactive (inactive = pooled / SetActive false). Returns total, active, inactive, activeAndEnabled, and name lists.
Read recent Unity Console entries (errors, warnings, logs) — use to debug compile/runtime errors
Read all components and their property values of a GameObject. Set deep=true for full reflection (private fields + all public properties, not just serialized ones).

deep.desc: Use deep reflection (private fields + all public properties)

commands.description: Add a component/script to a GameObject
Set a serialized property value on a component (e.g. maxHp=100). Leave component empty for Transform.

value.desc: Value as string (number/bool/text/enum, or 'x,y,z' for Vector3, '#RRGGBB' for Color)

commands.description: Set position/rotation/scale of a GameObject. 'set' lists which to apply: pos, rot, scale
Get currently selected GameObjects in the editor
Select a GameObject in the editor by name (and ping it)
Open a scene by asset path (prompts to save current changes)
Save all open scenes
Read the tail of the Unity Editor.log (full stack traces + Debug.Log history) — better than console for diagnosing hangs
Capture a runtime snapshot (isPlaying, paused, timeScale, frameCount, fps, network, spikes) — use to diagnose why the game is stuck/frozen. Call twice to check if frameCount advances.

Full performance audit: scene census (renderers, skinned meshes, particles, realtime lights, animators, mesh colliders), heavy object groups (e.g. trees x500, creeps x40), network ping/bandwidth/loss, heuristic warnings, and captured FPS spikes with their cause. Use to diagnose lag/FPS drops and recommend optimizations.
Clear the Unity console (use before reproducing a bug to isolate new errors)
Control Play Mode to reproduce/observe bugs: enter, exit, pause, resume, step
Read a project script's source with line numbers (optionally just one method) — use to cite exact problem lines

method.desc: Only return this method's body, e.g. Update

commands.description: Full profiler deep analysis: top GC allocators, CPU self-time per method, suspicious patterns (FindObjectOfType/Instantiate/LINQ in hot path), and actual source code of offenders with line numbers. Use after unity_perf_audit finds issues or when diagnosing stutters/lag spikes.

topN.desc: Top N offenders to show per category

commands.description: Memory usage snapshot: Mono heap/used, Unity native alloc/reserved, graphics driver memory, and GC collection counts per generation. Use to detect memory leaks, excess allocations, or high graphics memory usage.

Detailed Photon Fusion 2 network stats: current tick, tick rate, simulation time, per-player RTT, in/out bandwidth (KB/s), packet loss, resend rate, resimulation count, snapshot delta size. Requires Play mode with a NetworkRunner in scene.
Report the single worst FPS spike captured by the Auto Spike Monitor: frame time, GC culprit, CPU culprit, and actual source code of the offending method. Use after a stutter occurs in Play mode.

Scan all project .cs files and report refactoring opportunities: large classes, long/complex methods, high coupling (fan-in/fan-out), deep inheritance, public fields, magic numbers, and TODO debt. Returns top N offenders with severity scores and actionable issues.
Add a runtime watch: sample a field/property on a component every 0.5s during Play Mode and track trend. Use to observe HP, ammo, state, or any runtime value over time.

objectName.desc: GameObject name in scene (used in GameObject.Find)

field.desc: Field or property name, e.g. currentHp

commands.description: Get the current sampled values and trend for all active runtime watches. Shows last 10 values per watch with timestamps.
Remove all runtime watches
Get recent Unity exceptions and errors (rolling buffer of last 50, deduplicated). Sorted by lastSeen desc. Use to quickly surface runtime exceptions without opening the Console window.

Escape hatch — compile and run arbitrary C# against the live Editor/scene via Roslyn. Use ONLY when no dedicated tool fits: build prefabs from imported models, batch-edit assets, drive the AssetDatabase/importer, or prototype gameplay live. Provide a FULL C# source file in 'code'. Put logic in 'public static string Run()' (its return string is reported back), or define a MonoBehaviour (auto-attached to a new GameObject in the playing scene). All loaded assemblies (UnityEngine, UnityEditor, game asm) are referenced automatically. Requires Write ON. Make scripts idempotent — there is no retry, but rerunning should be safe.

code.desc: Full C# source. Logic in 'public static string Run()' (return value reported) or a MonoBehaviour (auto-attached live).

commands.description: Apply a targeted find/replace edit to an EXISTING project .cs file — the way to fix bugs/refactor without rewriting the whole file. Read the file with unity_read_script first to copy the exact text. After editing, call unity_compile then poll unity_compile_status until ready. Requires Write ON.

name.desc: Script name (e.g. PlayerController) — resolved via the codebase index

path.desc: Or the asset path directly, e.g. Assets/Scripts/PlayerController.cs (takes precedence over name)

find.desc: Exact existing text to replace (include enough surrounding lines to be unique)

replace.desc: Replacement text (empty to delete the matched text)

all.desc: Replace every occurrence; otherwise the match must be unique

commands.description: Assign an object/asset REFERENCE to a component field (what set_property can't do — it only handles primitives). Wires e.g. a GameObject/Component target or a prefab/material asset into a serialized object-reference field. Requires Write ON.

name.desc: GameObject name in the active scene that holds the component

property.desc: Object-reference field name on the component

target.desc: Scene GameObject name, OR an asset name/path. The right component on the target is picked to match the field type.

asset.desc: Force resolving 'target' as a project asset (not a scene object)

commands.description: Run multiple Unity commands in one call (build a whole scene/setup in a single round-trip). Each item is a normal command object and goes through the same write-gate/rate-limit. Max 50. Returns per-item ok/result. Requires Write ON.
Delete a project asset FILE (moves it to the OS trash — recoverable). Refuses folders, third-party/plugin paths, and anything outside Assets/. Requires Write ON.

path.desc: Asset path under Assets/, e.g. Assets/Prefabs/Old.prefab

commands.description: Change a texture's import settings (the fix that pairs with unity_audit_textures — apply its recommendations). Only the fields you pass are changed, then the asset is reimported. Requires Write ON.
Render the Game or Scene camera to a PNG on disk and return its file path — use to SEE the actual result after a change (great for Art/UI verification). Read-only.

Build a standalone/mobile player via BuildPipeline. Blocking and can take minutes (the bridge may time out while the build continues). Uses enabled Build Settings scenes unless 'scenes' is given. Switches the active build target if needed. Requires Write ON.

path.desc: Output path, e.g. Builds/win/Game.exe (or a folder for some targets)

target.desc: win64 | win32 | android | ios | webgl | mac | linux64; empty = current active target

scenes.desc: Override scene list, paths separated by ';' (default: enabled Build Settings scenes)

commands.description: Show the project's git branch and working-tree changes (porcelain) — use to see what was modified before suggesting a commit. Read-only.

Start a Unity Test Runner run and return immediately (results are async — poll unity_get_test_results until status='done'). EditMode by default; PlayMode enters play. Requires the com.unity.test-framework package. Requires Write ON.

mode.desc: EditMode (fast, no play) or PlayMode (enters play, slower)

filter.desc: Optional test-name regex (groupNames) to run a subset, e.g. 'MyNamespace.Combat.*'

commands.description: Poll the latest Unity Test Runner results: status (idle/running/done), pass/fail/skip/total counts, and the list of failed tests with messages. Call repeatedly after unity_run_tests until status='done'. Read-only.
